title: ceratosanthes palmata
intro: Ceratosanthes palmata, commonly known as the palmate ceratocephala or the five-angled palmate, is a plant species belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ceratosanthes palmata include its use as an antitussive and diaphoretic, helping to relieve cough and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
